Question
========
Suppose you wish to compute the average across multiple datasets stored in files. Which sequence of steps is correct?

Answerlist
-----------
* Read each file, compute its mean, ignore combining them
* Read each file into an array, sum all arrays, divide by number of files
* Read only the first file and assume others are identical
* Use numpy.max on each file and take the maximum of maxima
* Use matplotlib to compute the averages without reading data
* Read each file and store as strings only

Solution
========
You can average multiple datasets by summing arrays and dividing by the number of files.
